title: Home of the Whopper® / Wall example
slide_intent: Test a phrase on the material people encounter because texture and scale can change its readability and tone.
strategic_value: The brown lockup on wood can connect Burger King’s product claim to a warm restaurant environment.
demonstration: A large Home of the Whopper lockup runs across a wall of horizontal wooden boards.
practical_value: Compare the lockup’s hierarchy and contrast on a textured interior surface.

content_islands.name: Wooden wall
content_islands.spec: Let horizontal boards fill the page and preserve their grain and joints.

content_islands.name: Claim lettering
content_islands.spec: Place the brown lockup across the central wall, keeping the small stacked phrase beside the larger Whopper name.

reference_purposes.Expression: Dark rounded lettering and warm wooden boards create a coherent material and typographic treatment.
reference_purposes.Application: The signature claim is applied as interior wall lettering.
